featuresPage.title: Everything you need to master your data
featuresPage.subtitle: Discover a comprehensive suite of tools engineered for absolute security, seamless collaboration, and effortless file management.
featuresPage.coreSubtitle: The essential tools powering your everyday workflow.
featuresPage.futureSubtitle: We're constantly innovating. Here's a sneak peek at the powerful capabilities coming in our next major release.
featuresPage.secureAuthDesc: Robust Email and OAuth login with secure session management and detailed user profiles.
featuresPage.imageEncryptionDesc: Client-side AES-256 military-grade encryption for images and media files before cloud storage.
featuresPage.hiddenMediaDesc: Hide sensitive images, videos, and private files behind a personal 4-digit PIN code.
featuresPage.folderMgmtDesc: Full CRUD operations, hierarchical tree structure, and intuitive breadcrumb navigation.
featuresPage.fileOpsDesc: Drag-and-drop uploads, file pickers, renaming, moving, and instant downloads.
featuresPage.granularSharingDesc: Share securely with Viewer or Editor roles, revoke access instantly, and audit permissions.
featuresPage.shareLinksDesc: Generate shareable links with customizable expiration dates and optional password protection.
featuresPage.smartSearchDesc: Find exactly what you need by name, type, or owner, complete with dynamic sorting.
featuresPage.quickAccessDesc: Instantly jump back in with Recent files and organize your most important work with Favorites.
featuresPage.trashRecoveryDesc: Accidentally deleted something? Recover files easily within a 30-day retention window.
featuresPage.versionHistoryDesc: Keep current pointers and access archived versions of your files.
featuresPage.richPreviewsDesc: Instant in-app previews for images, PDFs, and basic text files with generated thumbnails.
featuresPage.auditLogsDesc: Comprehensive tracking of all file activities and workspace events.
featuresPage.advOrgDesc: Custom tags, powerful bulk actions, and lightning-fast keyboard shortcuts.
featuresPage.teamWorkspacesDesc: Shared drives for teams and deep content indexing for enterprise-grade search.
featuresPage.analyticsDesc: Detailed quotas and visually rich dashboards to monitor storage usage.

aboutPage.heroTitle: Redefining how the world stores its digital life.
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Founded on the belief that digital storage should be fast, beautiful, and unconditionally secure, CloudBox is building the infrastructure for tomorrow's digital economy.
aboutPage.storyP1: We started CloudBox because we were tired of compromising. We wanted the military-grade security of enterprise solutions, paired with the beautiful, frictionless design of modern consumer apps. When we couldn't find it, we built it.
aboutPage.storyP2: Today, we're a distributed team of engineers, designers, and security experts working across 12 countries. What unites us is a singular obsession: making digital file management invisible, so you can focus on the work that actually matters.
aboutPage.storyP3: We are independently funded, profitable, and beholden only to our users—not advertisers or data brokers.
aboutPage.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide every feature we ship and every decision we make.
aboutPage.value1Desc: We believe your data is yours alone. We employ military-grade encryption and zero-knowledge architecture to keep it that way.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Powerful tools shouldn't require a manual. We design intuitive, frictionless experiences that get out of your way.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Whether you're a freelancer or an enterprise team, our tools are built to seamlessly connect you with the people that matter.

footer.tagline: Building the infrastructure for tomorrow's digital economy. Secure, fast, and beautiful cloud storage for everyone.

termsPage.sec1P4: Accounts are non-transferable. You must notify CloudBox support immediately if you suspect any unauthorized access to your account.
